verdict.line: You lose if you let her stack Riposte parries into free trades before level 6; you win if you force isolated all-in windows where Death Realm traps her.

brief.thesis: This matchup is dead even at 49.7% over 346 games because both champions win with the same tool — forced 1v1 duels — but on opposite timers. Fiora wants short trades that bait a spell into W (Riposte) and then explodes you with Q (Lunge) resets before you reach two full item spikes; you want to survive to level 6 and beyond, where R (Death Realm) removes her escape and turns every all-in into a closed-arena death sentence.

theirWindow.what: She'll stand still baiting your Q (Obliterate) or E (Veil of Darkness) — if she plants her feet mid-trade, hold your spell cast and just auto, or she parries it and gets a free heal-into-burst window with her vitals procced.

yourWindow.when: level 6+, she's isolated near your minion wave
yourWindow.what: Flash-less all-in: E her to slow, R (Death Realm) the instant she commits Q (Lunge) so she can't recall or flash out mid-duel, then unload Q+W+passive echo. Riposte can't block Realm's pull, only the damage tick after.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 48.8% win over 289 games and 67.5% pick — the mana sustain lets you spam Q (Obliterate) in minion trades without oom, which matters since you can't out-duel her early without poke first.

boots.why: 84% pick, 49.1% win — Fiora's damage is entirely auto-attacks (her passive procs and Lunge resets are all physical), so the flat reduction directly counters her win condition.

core.why: The slow from E and R keeps her inside Death Realm and stops her kiting Lunge resets away from your Q.
Omnivamp lets you win extended trades even when she's parrying half your damage, and the true damage ramp punishes her stacking Ninja Tabi/tank items.

situational.when: she rushes her R (Grand Challenge) or has fed passive stacks by level 9
she's building full lethality/crit and out-damaging your sustain in extended fights
the enemy team stacks true damage or sustain-reduction items against your Riftmaker healing

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.3% pick at 54% win — Conqueror's ramping adaptive damage and sustain rewards the exact prolonged trades this matchup forces, and it doesn't get denied by Riposte the way a single burst spell would.

summoners.why: 83.7% pick at 50.3% win — Ignite denies her Riposte heal proc entirely and seals kills through her passive vitals sustain, which is the single biggest lever you have in an even lane.

playing.title: Bait spells with auto-attacks only
playing.detail: Never throw Q (Obliterate) or E (Veil of Darkness) into a stationary Fiora before level 6 — she's fishing for Riposte. Auto-trade instead and save your kit for when she commits Q (Lunge).

playing.title: Track her Lunge charge count
playing.detail: Fiora's Q resets on hit — if she's chained two Lunges already, her mobility is spent and she's stuck; that's your green light to E-slow and follow up.

playing.title: Hold Realm for isolation, not first blood
playing.detail: R (Death Realm) is your win condition vs her flash/dash escape — don't burn it on a random poke trade, wait until she's alone and already low.

playing.title: Freeze past level 6
playing.detail: Once Death Realm is live, freezing the wave near your tower invites her to overextend for CS, walking into your all-in radius.

playing.title: Respect Riposte after her ultimate
playing.detail: Her R (Grand Challenge) grants tenacity and lifesteal — don't start extended trades right as she pops it; let it tick down 2-3 seconds before committing your combo.

playing.title: Itemize Bramble on her power spike
playing.detail: If she's ahead of gold by level 9-10, rush Bramble Vest before Riftmaker — the grievous wounds cuts her Grand Challenge sustain in half.

playing.title: Use Ignite to deny outplay
playing.detail: Fiora vitals heal on 4 procs — Ignite's grievous wounds and burn damage removes that safety net, so apply it the moment she commits to trade, not after she's already low.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and the 49.7% head-to-head figure are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the timing windows, tells, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own tactical read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of having your [E] or [R] blocked by Fiora’s (W). Purchase Bramble Vest quickly in response to Fiora’s (R) and (P).
